subject: integration
name: Ethereum network standard (ETH_NET_0_1)
summary: Defines 16 reads of the Ethereum chain (balances, calls, logs, receipts, proofs, fees) and broadcasting a signed transaction, with a READONLY profile that keeps the reads. The row runs nothing and names no node. The definition has a conforming node follow CCIP-Read on a call, fetching from gateways a contract names, which then see the call; it does not require a node to prove its answers against a block header. Each provider is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
